Big Shark Long Route Shop Ride

Richmond Heights, MO · Road

Big Shark Long Route Shop Ride is a road group ride in Richmond Heights, MO. It rolls every Saturday at 7:30 am from Big Shark Bicycle Company, Big Bend.

Next ride Sat, Oct 3, 7:30 AM CDT

How we know

Big Shark's Group Rides calendar (Google Calendar ICS) has a weekly Saturday 7:30 am shop group road ride at 1155 S Big Bend running to Oct 3, 2026, and its rides page lists the 7:30 Long Route with a ride leader March 1 to Oct 31 (fetched Oct 1, 2026).

For visitors

Road bikes encouraged. Helmet required, no earbuds. From Nov 1 to Mar 1 there is no ride leader and routes change.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 16-19 mph: brisk — you'll want some fitness.
Check
Look at @bigsharkbicycleco the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Big Shark Long Route Shop Ride group ride

The faster of Big Shark's Saturday road options: a slightly rolling 31-mile loop at 16 to 19 mph. A medium and a short route leave at the same time. The shop calls these no-attack rides: you start and finish together.
